findings.source_quote: …right. No sacrifice is too hard for love to make. True love will enjoy what is given but its very nature cannot take that which is not voluntarily offered. Love is the path to life and freedom. There is no happiness in getting but only in giving. Many marriages exist with the attitude that happiness comes in having or in getting, but that is not God’s way. There would be few divorces if a husband worked as hard to keep his wife as he did to get her in the first place. Unselfishness is a normal attitude of love.
